name: @local-operator-mobile/ci-scripts
//: This manifest exists for one field: `type: module`. Node decides how to read
a .ts file from the nearest package.json, and the root one cannot say
`type: module` — metro.config.js is CommonJS and would break. Without this
file every invocation printed MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON on stderr and
Node reparsed the file as ESM, and `tsc` under `nodenext` treated the same
files as CommonJS, which `verbatimModuleSyntax` rejects outright. Scoping
the declaration to this directory fixes both without touching the app.
It declares no dependencies: these scripts run before `pnpm install`.
